summary: Border roles split into four weights (subtle/default/control/strong — ADR 0010). Inputs deliberately sit on border-subtle; --ui-border-control is the SC 1.4.11-conformant boundary, a one-token switch for engagements requiring strict form conformance. The resolver gains a non-text contrast audit (NONTEXT_CONTRAST_PAIRS, 3:1 floor) over border-focus, focus-ring-color and border-control; border-control is derived opaque so its measured contrast is defined. The focus ring itself was moved from brand blue-80 (1.5:1, failing) to blue-40 (5.6:1) during the handover review.

migration.manual: No consumers exist yet. Components built from Phase 2 onward reference border-subtle for resting inputs and may switch to border-control per engagement.
